currency_strength_note: Unweighted breadth across fresh directional 11-pair candidates, not an independent live currency strength index
higher_timeframe_rule: Daily and 4H are context, not a veto on early 15m directional watches; countertrend is not reversal
freshness_rule: Any stale primary candle blocks pair from technical watchlist; collection timestamp alone never proves candle freshness.
top_five_note: 50pct early price-rotation opportunity + 50pct directional structure. Reversal watches require NO breakout. New closed M15/M30 directional pressure overrides lagging EMA/legacy BUY direction when observed. All watches NEVER executable orders; macro/spreads UNVERIFIED.

reader_instructions: Check timestamps and source_valid. Compare with independently verified quote, news, yields, currency cross-cluster and ADR before ANY trade recommendation. If missing/stale, say unverified. Never present this watchlist as live Top 3.
active_episode_method: Preserve timestamp of first recorded direction regardless of EXTENDED/data-divergence; do not infer actual beginning of market move.
signal_history_method: Persist first observed valid directional scan, maintain across runs; never reset on unchanged direction
early_rotation_rule: AGGRESSIVE EARLY STRUCTURE ROTATION: 4-bar lower highs/lows, 15m/30m momentum, failed pushes, no breakout required. 5m watch only; 1H/4H context not vetoes; no execution approval.
